note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species; type locality San Antonio, La Guajira, Colombia, elevation 1800 m, collected by A. H. Fassl in 1909); the original describes the alate only (6 specimens); the soldier and the worker are not described. The measurements are translated verbatim from table 24 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Within the Neotropical Region the alate of this species has the longest wings (forewing 13.15—14.21 mm from the suture). Compared with G. hospitalis the compound eyes are larger and more protruding, the anterolateral corners of the pronotum more rounded, and the tibiae longer; in G. contracticornis the wings are shorter and narrower and the pronotum wider with rounded posterolateral margins.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum brown, the frons paler anteriorly; labrum concolorous with the anterior part of the head; antennae and legs pale yellow; wing scales brown with a yellowish tinge; wing membrane pale yellow, the costal area reddish brown, a few branches of the cubitus brown and the rest pale yellow. Head with a small number of scattered erect setae; labrum and pronotum densely covered with long and short setae; tibiae moderately hairy. Head wide. Y suture faintly visible. Compound eyes large; ocelli nearly oval, oblique, very close to the compound eyes (0.02 mm), touching them in some specimens. Antennae 14-segmented, the second segment longer than the third and fourth, the third equal to the fourth. Pronotum narrower than the head; anterior margin forming a broad angle; anterolateral corners broadly rounded; the posterior sides angled downwards to the slightly concave or straight posterior margin. Wings very long; media of the hind wing arising from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 1.65 mm from the suture. Measurements (mm; 6 alates, values in parentheses are the mean): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.58—1.72 (1.64); head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.28—1.35 (1.31); head width 1.39—1.47 (1.43); compound eye diameter 0.43—0.46 (0.44); distance below the compound eye 0.14—0.18 (0.15); ocellus length 0.14—0.16 (0.15); pronotum median length 0.70—0.75 (0.72), maximum length 0.86—0.90 (0.87), width 1.09—1.20 (1.15); hind tibia length 1.31—1.35 (1.34); forewing length (from the suture) 13.15—14.21 (13.57), width 3.32—3.39 (3.36).
